title: Furnishing Information to the Central Government

content.scenario: The National Commission receives a request from the Central Government to furnish information on the pendency of cases. The National Commission provides the required information in the prescribed form and manner.
content.outcome: The National Commission fulfils its statutory obligation to furnish information to the Central Government, as required under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What information is the National Commission required to furnish to the Central Government?
How often is the National Commission required to provide information to the Central Government?
What is the purpose of furnishing information to the Central Government?
